title: English Tests: Do They Improve Education?
speaker: Tom Wilkinson

keywords.def: made according to the same rules or system so that things can be compared fairly
a system in which people succeed because of their abilities or achievements rather than their social background
learning something through repetition and memorisation rather than understanding it deeply
working well without wasting time, money, or effort
the process of remembering or getting information from your memory
to use knowledge or skills learned in one situation in a different situation
happening naturally and without being planned or prepared in advance

sentences.en: Many of you listening to this episode will have spent (or currently are spending) months preparing for exams like IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, and the Cambridge English qualifications.
sentences.zh: 收听这期节目的很多人可能已经花了几个月（或者正在花时间）准备诸如雅思、托福、托业以及剑桥英语等考试。

sentences.en: Passing a proficiency test is often required if you want to study abroad, qualify for a new job, or move to another country.
sentences.zh: 如果你想出国留学、获得新工作资格或移居另一个国家，通常都需要通过英语熟练度测试。

sentences.en: But do proficiency tests actually help you in your goal to become fluent in English?
sentences.zh: 但英语熟练度测试真的能帮你实现流利说英语的目标吗？

sentences.en: For some people, English exams provide a clear goal to motivate your study and offer a fair way to measure language ability.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，英语考试提供了一个明确的目标来激励学习，并提供了一种公平衡量语言能力的方法。

sentences.en: Others believe tests encourage memorisation, reward good test-taking rather than good communication, and turn English into just another school subject.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为，考试助长了死记硬背，奖励的是擅长应试而非善于沟通的人，并把英语变成又一个死板的学校科目。

sentences.en: In today’s episode, I want to explore the history of testing, why English has become one of the world’s most tested subjects, and whether English proficiency exams actually improve education!
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我想探讨测试的历史、为什么英语会成为世界上被测试最多的学科之一，以及英语熟练度考试是否真的能改善教育！

sentences.en: If you think back to your own education, your own time at school, you’ve probably taken hundreds of tests and exams.
sentences.zh: 如果你回想自己的教育经历、在校时光，你可能参加过数百次测验和考试。

sentences.en: There were likely spelling tests and vocabulary quizzes when you were at school.
sentences.zh: 你在学校时可能经历过拼写测试和词汇小测验。

sentences.en: Maybe end of term exams and high school entrance exams.
sentences.zh: 也许还有期末考试和高中入学考试。

sentences.en: University entrance exams. Even your driving test and professional qualifications you need for your job.
sentences.zh: 大学入学考试。甚至还有你的驾照考试以及工作所需的专业资格认证。

sentences.en: Testing, taking exams, is such a normal part of education.
sentences.zh: 测试、参加考试，是教育中非常正常的一部分。

sentences.en: In fact, it’s so normal that we rarely think about the purpose of taking a test.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它太正常了，以至于我们很少去思考参加考试的目的。

sentences.en: It’s important we do think about the purpose, though, because not all tests are trying to do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 不过，思考其目的非常重要，因为并非所有测试的目的都完全相同。

sentences.en: It’s helpful to think about two different types of assessment: assessment of learning and assessment for learning.
sentences.zh: 思考两种不同类型的评估会很有帮助：对学习的评估和促进学习的评估。

sentences.en: Assessment of learning happens after learning has taken place.
sentences.zh: 对学习的评估发生在学习过程结束之后。

sentences.en: The purpose of assessment of learning is to measure what someone knows or what someone can do.
sentences.zh: 对学习的评估的目的，是衡量某人掌握了什么或能做什么。

sentences.en: These are tests like final exams or university entrance exams, and of course, English proficiency tests like IELTS, TOEFL, or the Cambridge English Qualifications.
sentences.zh: 这些就像是期末考试或大学入学考试，当然还有诸如雅思、托福或剑桥英语证书这样的英语熟练度测试。

sentences.en: These tests are designed to examine how well you have learned something.
sentences.zh: 这些测试旨在检验你对某事物的学习效果。

sentences.en: In the English proficiency test, it’s how well you have learned English.
sentences.zh: 在英语熟练度测试中，就是检验你英语学得有多好。

sentences.en: Assessment for learning has a different purpose.
sentences.zh: 促进学习的评估有着不同的目的。

sentences.en: Assessment for learning supports learning along the way.
sentences.zh: 促进学习的评估在整个过程中支持学习。

sentences.en: So this is when you take tests and quizzes as part of your studying.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是指你在学习过程中参加的测试和小测验。

sentences.en: These kinds of tests include a vocabulary quiz during a class, or a teacher correcting your writing or a tutor providing feedback after speaking in a conversation group.
sentences.zh: 这类测试包括课堂上的词汇小测验，或者老师批改你的写作，又或者导师在对话小组发言后提供反馈。

sentences.en: These types of assessments are designed to help you, to help learners, improve.
sentences.zh: 这些类型的评估旨在帮助你、帮助学习者不断进步。

sentences.en: This distinction, this difference, between assessment of learning and assessment for learning, is important because people often talk about testing as though every test has the same purpose.
sentences.zh: 这种区别，即对学习的评估与促进学习的评估之间的区别，非常重要，因为人们经常把测试混为一谈，好像每个测试的目的都一样。

sentences.en: But a weekly vocabulary quiz at the end of your school English class is very different to an IELTS exam, and in fact, these exams have very different goals.
sentences.zh: 但学校英语课结束时的每周词汇小测验与雅思考试截然不同，事实上，这些考试的目标大相径庭。

sentences.en: Testing has existed for longer than modern schools have existed.
sentences.zh: 测试的存在甚至比现代学校还要久远。

sentences.en: Taking tests is a very old thing. One of the earliest and most famous examples of testing comes from China.
sentences.zh: 参加考试是一件非常古老的事情。最早且最著名的测试例子之一来自中国。

sentences.en: More than 1,000 years ago, the Chinese Imperial Government was using civil service examinations to select officials, government officials.
sentences.zh: 1000多年前，中国古代封建朝廷就曾使用科举考试来选拔官员、政府官员。

sentences.en: To become a civil servant in China, you were expected to pass a series of difficult exams.
sentences.zh: 要想在中国成为一名官吏，你必须通过一系列高难度的考试。

sentences.en: These exams were usually based on Confucian philosophy and literature.
sentences.zh: 这些考试通常以儒家哲学和文学为基础。

sentences.en: These examinations were very innovative.
sentences.zh: 这些考试非常具有创新性。

sentences.en: It was an early example of a kind of meritocracy; the idea that a person’s ability and knowledge matters more than their family status or their wealth.
sentences.zh: 它是精英统治的一种早期体现；即一个人的能力和知识比其家族地位或财富更重要的理念。

sentences.en: But if we were to be critical over the Chinese civil service exams a thousand years ago, the success in the exam depended on years of memorizing texts.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们以批判的眼光来看待千年前的中国科举考试，考试的成功依赖于多年的文本背诵。

sentences.en: The system rewarded rote learning, so memorization, rather than rewarding creativity or original thinking.
sentences.zh: 该系统奖励死记硬背，即机械记忆，而不是奖励创造力或原创思维。

sentences.en: As education expanded around the world, but particularly in Europe, written examinations became more common in schools.
sentences.zh: 随着教育在世界范围内普及，特别是在欧洲，书面考试在学校中变得越来越普遍。

sentences.en: The invention of the printing press made it so much easier to produce exam papers and textbooks.
sentences.zh: 印刷术的发明使得印刷试卷和教科书变得容易得多。

sentences.en: Then there were more universities being founded, and with more universities, there needed to be ways to assess students.
sentences.zh: 随后，更多的大学建立起来，随着大学的增多，就需要有方法来评估学生。

sentences.en: Testing became even more important during the Industrial Revolution.
sentences.zh: 在工业革命期间，测试变得更加重要。

sentences.en: Governments gradually introduced compulsory education.
sentences.zh: 各国政府逐步推行义务教育。

sentences.en: This meant that everyone had to go to school, and now schools had to teach millions of children around the world.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每个人都必须去上学，现在学校必须教导全球数以百万计的儿童。

sentences.en: They also had to assess their students’ abilities.
sentences.zh: 他们还必须评估学生的能力。

sentences.en: How well were the students learning? What did they know?
sentences.zh: 学生学得怎么样？他们懂了什么？

sentences.en: Standardized tests, so the same test everywhere, is an efficient way to compare students’ performances and also compare the performance of schools.
sentences.zh: 标准化测试，即各地采用相同的测试，是比较学生表现以及学校表现的一种高效方法。

sentences.en: When I was at school, I took exams in every single subject.
sentences.zh: 我在学校时，每个学科都要考试。

sentences.en: Students are examined in mathematics, science, history, geography, English, other languages, even examined in art and drama and music.
sentences.zh: 学生要接受数学、科学、历史、地理、英语、其他语言的考核，甚至还要考美术、戏剧和音乐。

sentences.en: English, outside of schools, is probably the most tested subject of all, because it is the most popular foreign or second language to learn, and proficiency tests are very important.
sentences.zh: 在学校之外，英语可能是所有学科中被测试最多的，因为它作为最受欢迎的外语或第二语言，其熟练度测试非常重要。

sentences.en: In the past, learning a foreign language was a relatively specialized skill.
sentences.zh: 在过去，学习一门外语是一项相对小众的技能。

sentences.en: People would perhaps learn religious languages like Latin or Arabic.
sentences.zh: 人们或许会学习拉丁语或阿拉伯语等宗教语言。

sentences.en: Or maybe learn the language of countries they moved to or the language of their parents.
sentences.zh: 或者学习他们移居国的语言，又或者是父母的语言。

sentences.en: Diplomats and merchants and scholars or travelers might study different languages.
sentences.zh: 外交官、商人、学者或旅行者可能会学习不同的语言。

sentences.en: But for most people, there was little reason to study a foreign language.
sentences.zh: 但对大多数人来说，没有多少理由去学习外语。

sentences.en: In the 20th century, English gradually became more important around the world.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪，英语在全球范围内逐渐变得更加重要。

sentences.en: The British Empire initially took the language everywhere, and then the power and the influence of the United States has done similar things and spread English even further.
sentences.zh: 大英帝国最初将这门语言带到了世界各地，随后美国的力量和影响力也发挥了类似的作用，将英语进一步传播开来。

sentences.en: Today, English is used in business, education, science, technology, aviation and tourism.
sentences.zh: 今天，英语被广泛应用于商业、教育、科学、技术、航空和旅游业。

sentences.en: Millions of people need English. They need English to communicate.
sentences.zh: 数百万人需要英语。他们需要英语来沟通。

sentences.en: And they need to prove they can communicate in English.
sentences.zh: 并且他们需要证明自己能够用英语进行交流。

sentences.en: This need to prove your English ability has created a demand for standardized English proficiency tests.
sentences.zh: 这种证明自己英语能力的需求，催生了对标准化英语熟练度测试的需求。

sentences.en: Some of the most well-known are the Cambridge English Qualifications, which assess your English ability at different CEFR levels, so A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, and C2.
sentences.zh: 其中最知名的一些考试是剑桥英语证书，它们根据欧洲共同语言参考标准（CEFR）的不同级别来评估你的英语能力，即A1、A2、B1、B2、C1和C2。

sentences.en: The TOEFL exam or the Test of English as a Foreign Language was developed mainly for students applying for universities in English-speaking countries, especially the USA.
sentences.zh: 托福考试主要面向申请英语国家尤其是美国大学的学生开发。

sentences.en: The IELTS exam or the International English Language Testing System is also widely used for university admissions and immigration in places like the UK, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 雅思考试也广泛用于英国、澳大利亚、加拿大和新西兰等地的大学招生和移民。

sentences.en: The TOEIC exam focuses on English in professional and workplace settings.
sentences.zh: 托业考试侧重于专业和职场环境中的英语。

sentences.en: There’s even the Duolingo English Test, which is an online English proficiency test that can be completed from home, and there’s many more that I have not mentioned.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有Duolingo英语测试，这是一种可以在家中完成的在线英语熟练度测试，还有很多我没有提到的考试。

sentences.en: There’s Pearson, LanguageCert. There’s so many different proficiency tests out there.
sentences.zh: 还有Pearson、LanguageCert。市面上有各种各样不同的熟练度测试。

sentences.en: These exams all share the same basic purpose.
sentences.zh: 这些考试都有着相同的基本目的。

sentences.en: They provide a standard way of measuring English proficiency.
sentences.zh: 它们提供了一种衡量英语熟练程度的标准方法。

sentences.en: A person can take IELTS in Bangladesh, Brazil, and Botswana, and their level can be compared.
sentences.zh: 一个人可以在孟加拉国、巴西和博茨瓦纳参加雅思考试，其水平可以进行横向比较。

sentences.en: This is really important. Someone working at the immigration agency of a country has to decide whether someone has the language skills to qualify for the visa they’re applying for.
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要。一个国家移民局的工作人员必须决定某人是否具备申请签证所需的语言技能。

sentences.en: Interviewing every single applicant individually would be a very inefficient way to test English ability.
sentences.zh: 单独面试每一位申请人，将是测试英语能力的一种极其低效的方法。

sentences.en: So people trust standardized tests like IELTS or the Cambridge English qualifications.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们信任像雅思或剑桥英语证书这样的标准化测试。

sentences.en: They trust these tests to fairly and accurately measure a person’s ability.
sentences.zh: 他们信任这些测试能够公平、准确地衡量一个人的能力。

sentences.en: This is a good example of assessment of learning.
sentences.zh: 这是对学习的评估的一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: These exams aren’t designed to improve your English.
sentences.zh: 这些考试不是为了提高你的英语水平而设计的。

sentences.en: They’re designed to measure your English.
sentences.zh: 它们是为了衡量你的英语水平而设计的。

sentences.en: They’re designed to measure the level of English that someone has already achieved.
sentences.zh: 它们旨在衡量某人已经达到的英语水平。

sentences.en: In my personal experience, preparing for a language proficiency test and exam can be a genuinely positive experience.
sentences.zh: 根据我的个人经验，为语言熟练度测试和考试做准备可以是一种真正积极的体验。

sentences.en: I’ve taken quite a few Japanese language proficiency tests in the past, and I’ve always found it quite rewarding to study towards a target.
sentences.zh: 我过去参加过不少日语能力测试，我一直觉得朝着一个目标学习非常有成就感。

sentences.en: Having a test gives you a clear target to work towards.
sentences.zh: 参加考试能给你一个努力争取的明确目标。

sentences.en: For example, you can aim for an IELTS score of 7.0 or a Cambridge C1 certificate.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以把目标定在雅思7.0分或剑桥C1证书。

sentences.en: That is a specific goal, a specific objective.
sentences.zh: 这是一个具体的目标，一个具体的指标。

sentences.en: You can put your full focus and dedicate yourself to one target: passing that test.
sentences.zh: 你可以集中全部精力，致力于一个目标：通过那个考试。

sentences.en: English tests also provide a common standard.
sentences.zh: 英语考试还提供了一个共同的标准。

sentences.en: If someone says they have a B2 or a C1 level of English, you can kind of understand their level.
sentences.zh: 如果有人说他们的英语水平达到了B2或C1级别，你大致能理解他们的水平。

sentences.en: Universities and employers have a reasonable idea of what that means.
sentences.zh: 大学和雇主对这意味着什么有一个合理的概念。

sentences.en: Without a standardized assessment, without something like the CEFR scale, which grades people’s ability, it would be so much harder to compare qualifications.
sentences.zh: 如果没有标准化评估，如果没有像对人们能力进行分级的CEFR量表这样的东西，比较资质就会难得多。

sentences.en: Perhaps the strongest argument in favor of taking tests isn’t actually about those high-stakes proficiency tests like IELTS or TOEFL.
sentences.zh: 支持考试的最有力论据，可能其实并不是关于雅思或托福那样的高风险熟练度测试。

sentences.en: Educational research has consistently found something called the “testing effect “.
sentences.zh: 教育研究一直发现一种被称为“测试效应”的现象。

sentences.en: The testing effect is also known as “retrieval practice “.
sentences.zh: 测试效应也被称为“提取练习”。

sentences.en: The basic idea of the testing effect is that trying to remember information strengthens your memory.
sentences.zh: 测试效应的基本理念是，试图回忆信息会增强你的记忆力。

sentences.en: In fact, it strengthens your memory more than reading or reviewing information Trying to remember vocabulary usually leads to a much better long-term understanding.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它比阅读或复习信息更能增强记忆力，试图回忆词汇通常会带来好得多的长期理解。

sentences.en: This is why regular quizzes and regular practice tests are a really effective learning tool.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么定期的小测验和定期练习测试是真正有效的学习工具。

sentences.en: They are actively helping you remember what you have learned.
sentences.zh: 它们在积极地帮助你记住你所学的内容。

sentences.en: A short vocabulary quiz at the end of your English lesson is going to help you move new words into your long-term memory.
sentences.zh: 英语课结束时的一个简短词汇小测验，将帮助你把新单词存入长期记忆中。

sentences.en: Despite these benefits, testing, and English testing in particular, has plenty of critics.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些好处，测试，尤其是英语测试，也招来了大量的批评。

sentences.en: The most common criticism is something known as “teaching to the test “.
sentences.zh: 最常见的批评被称为“应试教育”。

sentences.en: This goes back to the main purpose of studying English.
sentences.zh: 这要追溯到学习英语的主要目的。

sentences.en: Are you studying English to become a confident English speaker and a confident English user?
sentences.zh: 你学英语是为了成为一个自信的英语发言者和自信的英语使用者吗？

sentences.en: Or are you passing an exam in English just to graduate from high school, or just to get admitted to university, or just to qualify for a visa or get a new job?
sentences.zh: 还是你参加英语考试仅仅是为了高中毕业，或是为了被大学录取，又或是为了获得签证资格或找到新工作？

sentences.en: Formal English classes at school tend towards teaching to the test.
sentences.zh: 学校里的正式英语课程往往倾向于应试教育。

sentences.en: Teachers get judged on their students’ test results.
sentences.zh: 老师们根据学生的考试成绩受到评价。

sentences.en: They don’t get judged on students’ real-life English ability.
sentences.zh: 他们不会根据学生的现实生活英语能力受到评价。

sentences.en: This leads to pressure to focus on specific question types and specific exam conditions.
sentences.zh: 这导致了聚焦于特定题型和特定考试条件的压力。

sentences.en: The skills you need to pass an exam, like writing an IELTS-style answer, probably doesn’t transfer to real-life communication.
sentences.zh: 通过考试所需的技能，比如写一篇雅思风格的答案，可能无法转化为现实生活中的沟通。

sentences.en: And students, especially at high school, are often more focused on what comes after high school than studying English for the benefits of English itself.
sentences.zh: 而且学生们，尤其是高中生，往往更关注高中毕业后的事情，而不是为了英语本身的益处去学习英语。

sentences.en: When I studied French at high school, I was not particularly interested in becoming a French speaker.
sentences.zh: 我在高中学法语时，并不是特别对成为一个法语说者感兴趣。

sentences.en: I am not a French speaker at all, but I was interested in the qualification I would get for studying French.
sentences.zh: 我根本不是一个说法语的人，但我对通过学法语能获得的文凭很感兴趣。

sentences.en: The GCSE as it’s called in England, and that would help me get admitted to college, so after high school, and then eventually into university as well.
sentences.zh: 也就是英国所称的GCSE，这能帮我考上大学，也就是高中毕业后，并最终进入大学。

sentences.en: You’ve probably seen things like this yourselves in your language learning journeys.
sentences.zh: 你们在自己的语言学习历程中可能也见过类似的情况。

sentences.en: I definitely have in my Japanese learning journey.
sentences.zh: 我在日语学习历程中绝对经历过。

sentences.en: In fact, I have quite a few Japanese learning textbooks that focus or give tips on exam technique.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我有很多日语学习教材，它们侧重于或提供关于考试技巧的建议。

sentences.en: If you learn how the listening part of the exam usually goes, how it usually works, what the format is, you can sometimes predict answers or prepare yourself for answers.
sentences.zh: 如果你了解考试的听力部分通常是怎么进行的、通常如何运作、格式是什么，你有时就能预测答案或为答案做准备。

sentences.en: Or you can learn to speed read or skim read.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以学会速读或略读。

sentences.en: This is where you read through a text quickly just looking for the important and relevant information or the answers to your questions.
sentences.zh: 这是指快速浏览文本，只寻找重要且相关的信息或你问题的答案。

sentences.en: Or maybe you remember essay structures, you remember phrases, you remember a system of writing specifically for a test.
sentences.zh: 或者也许你记住了议论文结构、记住了短语、记住了专门针对考试的写作体系。

sentences.en: These are all strategies that will help you pass an exam.
sentences.zh: 这些都是能帮你通过考试的策略。

sentences.en: But these strategies will not make you better at English overall.
sentences.zh: 但这些策略不会让你整体的英语水平变得更好。

sentences.en: If you want to sit down and read a classic English novel like Pride and Prejudice, and enjoy the experience of reading this great work of literature, the ability to speed read and skim read texts looking for important information isn’t really helpful.
sentences.zh: 如果你想坐下来读一本经典的英文小说，比如《傲慢与偏见》，并享受阅读这部伟大文学作品的体验，那种寻找重要信息的速读和略读能力其实并没有什么帮助。

sentences.en: You want to sit there and enjoy the writing.
sentences.zh: 你想坐在那里享受文字。

sentences.en: You don’t want to look quickly through the page and pick out the information that’s relevant to a question.
sentences.zh: 你不会想快速翻阅页面去挑选与某个问题相关的信息。

sentences.en: Another criticism of exams is that these kinds of tests only measure part of a language.
sentences.zh: 对考试的另一种批评是，这类测试只能衡量语言的一部分。

sentences.en: They only measure part of what it means to know a language.
sentences.zh: 它们只能衡量了解一门语言所代表的一部分意义。

sentences.en: A good English speaker knows how to keep a conversation going, knows how to tell a story in an engaging way, how to understand humor and make jokes, how to adjust the language for different situations.
sentences.zh: 一个好的英语使用者知道如何维持对话，知道如何以引人入胜的方式讲故事，如何理解幽默和开玩笑，如何根据不同情况调整语言。

sentences.en: These skills are really difficult to measure in an exam.
sentences.zh: 这些技能在考试中真的很难衡量。

sentences.en: How can you test someone’s comprehension of a joke or their ability to detect sarcasm?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能测试一个人对笑话的理解力或他们察觉讽刺的能力呢？

sentences.en: Testing also creates a lot of pressure and a lot of stress.
sentences.zh: 测试也会带来很大的压力和焦虑。

sentences.en: You need to spend months preparing for that exam and probably spend a lot of money to take the exam.
sentences.zh: 你需要花几个月时间准备考试，可能还要花很多钱去参加考试。

sentences.en: When I take my Japanese proficiency tests, I need to travel to a different city’cause there’s no testing center where I live.
sentences.zh: 当我参加日语能力测试时，我需要去另一个城市，因为我住的地方没有考点。

sentences.en: I need to book a hotel for the night before and pay for my transport there.
sentences.zh: 我需要提前一晚预订酒店，并支付去那里的交通费。

sentences.en: I need to pay the fee for taking the exam.
sentences.zh: 我需要支付考试报名费。

sentences.en: And then there’s a lot of pressure. In fact, your condition on that specific day, the specific day you take the test, is going to affect your performance.
sentences.zh: 然后还有很大的压力。事实上，你在那个特定日期的状态，也就是你参加测试的那一天，会影响你的表现。

sentences.en: You might have caught influenza and then take the exam and fail badly.
sentences.zh: 你可能刚好得了流感，然后去考试并且考得很惨。

sentences.en: That’s not a reflection on your actual ability.
sentences.zh: 这并不反映你的真实能力。

sentences.en: That is a reflection on your condition of the day.
sentences.zh: 这反映的是你当天的状态。

sentences.en: It’s a reflection of how you were. You might have been really tired.
sentences.zh: 这反映了你当时的状况。你可能真的很累。

sentences.en: You might have had a headache. There might have been someone coughing behind you throughout the listening test.
sentences.zh: 你可能头痛。在听力测试期间，你身后可能一直有人在咳嗽。

sentences.en: Doesn’t mean that you are a bad English speaker or have a bad understanding of English, if you perform badly in a test.
sentences.zh: 如果你在测试中表现不佳，并不意味着你是一个糟糕的英语使用者，或者对英语的理解很差。

sentences.en: I had a friend at high school who was really intelligent in class and did really well in all of the practice tests, but he got so nervous in exams that he kept fainting during high school.
sentences.zh: 我在高中有个朋友，他在课堂上非常聪明，在所有练习测试中都表现得很好，但他一到考试就紧张得要命，在高中期间一直晕倒。

sentences.en: And he kept falling off his chair during our official standardized tests at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 在年底我们的官方标准化测试中，他一直从椅子上摔下来。

sentences.en: The test of course did not reflect his actual ability, and eventually he was allowed to take exams in a room by himself just with a teacher present, and his performance was so much better because he didn’t have as much stress or pressure.
sentences.zh: 这场考试当然没有反映出他的真实能力，最终他被允许独自在一个只有老师在场的房间里考试，他的表现好多了，因为他没有那么大的压力和焦虑。

sentences.en: He was allowed to be a bit more relaxed.
sentences.zh: 他被允许稍微放松一点。

sentences.en: Cost is another issue. English proficiency tests are expensive, and if you don’t get the score you need, then you’re going to have to take the test again.
sentences.zh: 费用是另一个问题。英语熟练度测试很贵，如果你没有考到你需要的分数，那么你就得再考一次。

sentences.en: If you can afford to have a private tutor, or you can afford to take an exam multiple times, you will have an advantage over people with less money.
sentences.zh: 如果你负担得起私人导师，或者你负担得起多次参加考试，你就会比缺钱的人更有优势。

sentences.en: The exam system, the way that English is measured, changes the style of teaching.
sentences.zh: 考试系统，即衡量英语水平的方式，改变了教学风格。

sentences.en: The style of teaching moves towards activities that improve test scores.
sentences.zh: 教学风格转向了那些能提高考试成绩的活动。

sentences.en: If you take classes with an IELTS specialty teacher, you will spend a lot of time working on exam preparation.
sentences.zh: 如果你跟着雅思专业老师上课，你会花大量时间做考试准备。

sentences.en: That’s probably what you want if you’re taking classes with an IELTS teacher.
sentences.zh: 如果你在跟雅思老师上课，这可能正是你想要的。

sentences.en: But you will lose out on all of the other parts of language learning.
sentences.zh: 但你会失去语言学习的所有其他部分。

sentences.en: You won’t have as much opportunity for creativity.
sentences.zh: 你不会有那么多发挥创造力的机会。

sentences.en: You won’t have as much opportunity for spontaneous conversation.
sentences.zh: 你不会有那么多进行即兴对话的机会。

sentences.en: You might not even enjoy the class, and enjoyment is a really important part of learning.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能不喜欢这门课，而快乐是学习中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Many of the problems I’ve been mentioning appear when assessment of learning, instead of assessment for learning, dominates the education system.​
sentences.zh: 我提到的许多问题，都出现在对学习的评估主导了教育系统，而不是促进学习的评估的时候。

sentences.en: Do English tests improve education? English tests definitely have an important purpose.
sentences.zh: 英语考试能改善教育吗？英语考试绝对有其重要的目的。

sentences.en: A university needs a way to compare applicants from different countries, and an employer, a company, needs evidence that someone has language skills.
sentences.zh: 大学需要一种方法来比较来自不同国家的申请者，雇主和公司需要证据证明某人具备语言技能。

sentences.en: In these kinds of situations, assessment of learning is practical and necessary.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，对学习的评估是实用且必要的。

sentences.en: We need some method, some way, of comparing people’s English abilities.
sentences.zh: 我们需要某种方法、某种途径来比较人们的英语能力。

sentences.en: But the ultimate goal of learning a language is to communicate.
sentences.zh: 但学习语言的终极目标是沟通。

sentences.en: Teaching to the test can sometimes forget this purpose.
sentences.zh: 应试教育有时会忘记这个目的。

sentences.en: When you guys were at school, did your school teach to the test, or did your school teach you English?
sentences.zh: 你们在学校时，你们的学校是搞应试教育，还是教你们英语？

sentences.en: These are different things. I used to work in Japanese junior high schools and elementary schools, and I can confidently say that none of the classes I worked in were learning English for the ability to use English in real life.
sentences.zh: 这是两码事。我过去曾在日本的初中和小学工作过，我可以自信地说，我工作过的班级没有一个是在为了在现实生活中使用英语的能力而学习英语。

sentences.en: They were learning English so at the end of the year they could pass the junior high school exams and get into high school.
sentences.zh: 他们学英语是为了在年底通过初中考试并考入高中。

sentences.en: This meant the students were getting really good at taking the tests, but could not have a conversation.
sentences.zh: 这意味着学生们的应试能力变得很强，但却无法进行对话。

sentences.en: Research suggests that taking regular quizzes and practice tests can improve memory and can help students and teachers learn how to improve.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，定期进行小测验和练习测试可以改善记忆力，并能帮助学生和老师了解如何改进。

sentences.en: So there needs to be a balance between different types of test.
sentences.zh: 因此，不同类型的测试之间需要保持平衡。

sentences.en: Using tests like vocabulary tests or quizzes, practice tests in class is a great way to improve your ability.
sentences.zh: 使用词汇测试或小测验、课堂练习测试是提高你能力的好方法。

sentences.en: It’s a great way to study. It should be a way to improve your memory This doesn’t mean that you shouldn’t take exams like IELTS or TOEFL.
sentences.zh: 这是学习的好方法。它应该成为一种改善记忆力的方法。这并不意味着你不应该参加雅思或托福等考试。

sentences.en: Of course not. You should take them if you want to, if you need to.
sentences.zh: 当然不是。如果你想考、需要考，你就应该去考。

sentences.en: IELTS and TOEFL are milestones. They’re useful qualifications, but they’re not the purpose of learning the language.
sentences.zh: 雅思和托福是里程碑。它们是有用的资质证明，但它们不是学习语言的目的。

sentences.en: The purpose of learning English, for most of you, hopefully, is to improve your ability to communicate with other speakers of English.
sentences.zh: 对你们大多数人来说，学习英语的目的，希望是提高你与其他英语使用者沟通的能力。

sentences.en: To improve your ability to read English, to improve your ability to listen and speak and write.
sentences.zh: 提高你阅读英语的能力，提高你听、说、写的能力。

sentences.en: That’s the purpose of learning English. It’s not to take an IELTS exam.
sentences.zh: 那才是学习英语的目的。而不是去参加雅思考试。

sentences.en: But what do you think? Have you ever taken a proficiency test?
sentences.zh: 但你怎么看？你参加过熟练度测试吗？

sentences.en: What was English teaching like when you were younger at school?
sentences.zh: 你年轻时在学校里的英语教学是什么样的？

sentences.en: Did your teachers teach to the test? Does your country’s education system teach to the test rather than teaching English?
sentences.zh: 你的老师们是搞应试教育吗？你们国家的教育系统是搞应试教育，还是在教授真正的英语？
